logo.name: Logo & favicon
logo.logo_info: SVG or PNG with transparent background. Without a logo the shop name is shown as a text logo.

colors.name: Colors
colors.surface_info: Used for cards, product images and highlights.
colors.background_gradient_info: Optional. Replaces the background color – check text contrast.
colors.contrast_info: Keep at least 4.5:1 contrast against the background for accessibility.
colors.accent_info: Used for links and focus outlines. At least 4.5:1 contrast against the background.
colors.border_strong_info: At least 3:1 contrast against the background.

typography.name: Typography
typography.info: Fonts are served from the Shopify CDN. Every additional font weight adds loading time.
typography.body_font_info: Recommended: Inter 400. The 600 weight is added automatically for emphasis.

layout.name: Layout
layout.animations_info: Subtle reveal on scroll. Automatically disabled when visitors prefer reduced motion.

shipping.name: Shipping
shipping.info: These values only control what the theme displays. Actual shipping rates are set in Settings → Shipping and delivery – keep both in sync.

header.name: Header
header.menu_info: Links to collections without products are hidden automatically.

footer.name: Footer
footer.legal_menu_info: Leave empty to link the store policies from Settings → Policies automatically.

menu.name: Menu column
menu.heading: Heading
menu.heading_info: Leave empty to use the menu name.

announcement_bar.name: Announcement bar
announcement_bar.text_info: Leave empty for the automatic free shipping text from Theme settings → Shipping.
